items.title: Save All Media
items.subtitle: Save every image, GIF and video in a gallery, Imgur album or ImageChest post at once, from the full-screen and long-press menus.

items.title: Settings Shortcuts
items.subtitle: Press and hold the Settings tab to jump straight to up to 15 settings pages. Choose them under Interface > Tab Bar.

items.title: Redesigned Hidden & Deleted
items.subtitle: A native feed of archived posts and comments, with status flairs, inline albums and its own row on the profile.

items.title: Smoother List Editing
items.subtitle: Animated edit controls, aligned favourite stars and rows that shrink away when you remove them.

items.title: Cloud AI on GPT-6
items.subtitle: Summaries work on the new gpt-6 models, and adapt on their own to models Apollo doesn't know yet.
